chapterTitle: Chapter 9: Capital Letters and Full Stops 🅰️.
learningGoals: Understand that every new sentence wakes up with a big capital letter. ☀️
Learn that special names of people and places always get a big starting letter. 🌟
Know that a sentence needs a full stop at the very end to take a rest. 🛑
Practice writing short, beautiful sentences with the correct marks. ✍️
teachingTips: Read a favorite storybook together and ask your child to be a detective and find the 'big letters' at the start of sentences. 🕵️‍♂️📖
Play 'Find the Dot' by hunting for full stops on a printed page. Celebrate every time they find one! 🎉
Write your family members' names on a whiteboard and highlight the starting capital letter in a different color. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦🖍️
When they say a full sentence out loud, playfully ask them to shout 'Capital!' at the start and say 'Full stop!' at the end. 🗣️

funActivities.title: Name Card Maker 🏷️
funActivities.description: Help your child create colorful name cards for their friends, family, and favorite toys. Remind them to use a bright, big capital letter for the first letter of every special name! 🖍️🧸

funActivities.title: Red Dot Hunt 🔴
funActivities.description: Give your child a red sketch pen or crayon. Let them look through an old magazine or newspaper and draw a little red circle over every full stop they can find. It is a great visual exercise! 📰👀

funActivities.title: Sticky Note Sentences 📝
funActivities.description: Write simple words on sticky notes and let your child arrange them to build a short sentence (like 'The cat is big'). Have them add a special sticky note with a big full stop at the very end to close it! 🧩⭐
